evidence.reason: At line 1306, interrupt_phase accepts any non-zero/non-None status as proof of the injected switch kill. An ordinary failure exit 1 after the drained journal is written and the service is masked could therefore satisfy this check and the later state assertions, so the proof cannot distinguish the injected signal from a non-kill error. The nearby recover_kill_phase at line 1342 demonstrates the intended exact check (rc == -9). The finding is a routine test-harness correctness defect, not a new requirement.
